article.headline: New York visits Toronto following overtime win against Toronto
article.description: New York Knicks (7-6, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (5-8, ninth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: New York visits Toronto following overtime win against Toronto
article.linkText: New York visits Toronto following overtime win against Toronto
article.story: New York Knicks (7-6, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (5-8, ninth in the Eastern Conference) Toronto; Tuesday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: New York visits the Toronto Raptors after the Knicks took down the Toronto Raptors 112-108 in overtime. The Raptors are 0-3 against division opponents. Toronto is second in the NBA with 14.0 offensive rebounds per game led by Scottie Barnes averaging 2.7 offensive boards. The Knicks are 7-6 against Eastern Conference opponents. New York is second in the Eastern Conference giving up just 104.0 points while holding opponents to 43.3% shooting. The Raptors make 45.3% of their shots from the field this season, which is 2.0 percentage points higher than the Knicks have allowed to their opponents (43.3%). The Knicks average 14.7 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.0 more made shots on average than the 12.7 per game the Raptors allow. The teams meet for the second time this season. The Knicks won 112-108 in overtime in the last matchup on Nov. 15. TOP PERFORMERS: Barnes is averaging 24.2 points, 7.8 rebounds, five assists and 2.1 steals for the Raptors. RJ Barrett is averaging 20.7 points over the last 10 games. OG Anunoby is scoring 16.4 points per game and averaging 5.4 rebounds for the Knicks. Jalen Brunson is averaging 27.9 points and 2.6 rebounds over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Raptors: 3-7, averaging 113.8 points, 40.7 rebounds, 28.8 assists, 9.1 steals and 3.9 blocks per game while shooting 46.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.5 points per game. Knicks: 7-3, averaging 112.4 points, 47.9 rebounds, 27.4 assists, 7.8 steals and 4.0 blocks per game while shooting 44.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 102.8 points. INJURIES: Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: out (foot), Scottie Barnes: day to day (adductor). Knicks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
